raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Scope

Add a deterministic split-K plan for `matmul_persistent` on long-K, skinny-N projections. The split plan depends only on `(K, N)` and dtype, while `M` changes only the scheduling path. Partial results reduce in ascending K order, apply bias once, and round once.

## Reproduction

The existing determinism test file was used; no new test file is required by this PR.

### H20 command on the current PR head

```text
$ timeout 180s /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/v1/determinism/test_matmul_batch_invariant.py -k split --tb=short
.                                                                        [100%]
1 passed, 190 deselected in 0.64s
pytest_exit=0
```

The test was run from a temporary checkout of PR head `3fd527740a15` on an NVIDIA H20-3e. The existing compatible `_vllm_fa2_C` and `_vllm_fa3_C` artifacts from the local vLLM build were reused; this PR does not modify FlashAttention sources or extensions.

### H20 environment used for the test

```text
Python 3.12.15
PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130
flashinfer-python 0.7.1
ninja 1.13.2
lm_eval 0.4.13
```

### End-to-end accuracy attempt

```text
$ export CUDA_HOME=/home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13
$ export VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0
$ /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/lm_eval --model vllm --model_args pretrained=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,dtype=bfloat16,gpu_memory_utilization=0.9 --tasks gsm8k --batch_size 1 --limit 1
...
torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 4.00 GiB. GPU 0 has a total capacity of 139.80 GiB of which 2.44 GiB is free.
lm_eval_exit=1
```

The command now reaches vLLM model initialization. The single-GPU command from the original body uses `tensor_parallel_size=1`, while this model needs multi-GPU loading; no accuracy claim is made from this OOM run.

### End-to-end serving benchmark command

```text
$ timeout 60s /home/ljj/vllm-pr-59863/.venv/bin/vllm bench serve --backend openai-chat --base-url http://127.0.0.1:9256 --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --model /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 --num-prompts 1 --request-rate inf --ignore-eos
Successful requests:                     0
Failed requests:                         1
Request throughput (req/s):              0.00
Output token throughput (tok/s):         0.00
bench_exit=0
```

The serving endpoint was not running at `127.0.0.1:9256`, so no end-to-end throughput claim is made here.

## Review notes

The implementation keeps the default non-BI path unchanged and isolates the fixed split-K arithmetic contract from the batch-size-dependent scheduling choice.

## H20 integrated end-to-end validation (2026-11-03)

This supplement supersedes earlier single-GPU OOM or missing-server attempts **for the integrated DeepSeek-V4 stack only**. It does not claim that this individual PR head alone passes the full-model run. The tested integration commit is `5931b43d3287c1486fb319d1e5687cbe43c8bf00`, combining the V4 split PRs, follow-up integration fixes and the H20 FlashInfer top-k fallback in [inaniloquentee/vllm#6](https://github.com/inaniloquentee/vllm/pull/6). Code and raw logs are confined to `/home/ljj`; no repository test file was added for this validation.

H20-3e, TP8, model `/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base`, `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`, `VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=1`, `VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse`, `VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0`. Same model/configuration on upstream main `7651825993d001759107c66cdf6983535900c874` (raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-main-baseline-20261103/fullmodel-tp-eager-main-2.log`):

```text
ValueError: FP8 MoE backend DEEPGEMM does not support the deployment configuration since kernel does not support batch invariance.
```

Main cannot reach a same-BI `lm_eval` or serving benchmark, so there is no comparable main throughput claim. An intermediate integrated stack `71f3d9aa9` with SM100-only DeepSelect on H20 also failed graph capture (raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service/server.log`):

```text
CUDA error (/workspace/.deps/deepselect-src/csrc/cuda_kernels/v3_fp32/instantiations/../topk_select.cuh:590): no kernel image is available for execution on the device
```

After integrating the H20 dispatch, the exact full-model command runs under the same Slurm eight-GPU allocation. The external test script is `/home/ljj/tmp/run-dsv4-fullmodel-e2e-20261103.sh`; it checks token IDs, generated logprobs and prompt logprobs for 128/512/2048 tokens in three batch positions:

```bash
srun --partition=h20 --nodelist=vllm-sgp-h20-03 --gres=gpu:8 --cpus-per-task=64 --mem=512G --time=03:00:00 --export=ALL,REPO=/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103,MODEL=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,RESULT=/home/ljj/tmp/dsv4-e2e-zero-diff-5931b43d3.json,VLLM_DS4_DECODE_KERNEL=sparse bash /home/ljj/tmp/run-dsv4-fullmodel-e2e-20261103.sh
# Repeat with DSV4_E2E_GRAPH=1, DSV4_E2E_EP=1, and both set to 1.
```

Raw final line in each of `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/fullmodel-tp-eager-7.log`, `fullmodel-tp-graph-5931.log`, `fullmodel-ep-eager-5931.log`, `fullmodel-ep-graph-5931.log`:

```text
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
PASS: 9 full-model exact comparisons
```

Serve the same commit with:

```bash
vllm serve /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len 16384 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.82 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256
vllm bench serve --model /home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base --dataset-name random --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9256 --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1 --request-rate inf --num-prompts 128 --num-warmups 16
lm-eval run --model local-completions --model_args base_url=http://127.0.0.1:9256/v1/completions,model=/home/ljj/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base,num_concurrent=64 --tasks gsm8k --trust_remote_code
```

Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service-flashinfer/bench-serve.log`:

```text
============ Serving Benchmark Result ============
Successful requests:                     128
Failed requests:                         0
Benchmark duration (s):                  120.00
Total input tokens:                      1048576
Total generated tokens:                  128
Request throughput (req/s):              1.07
Output token throughput (tok/s):         1.07
Total token throughput (tok/s):          8738.89
```

Raw `/home/ljj/vllm-dsv4-e2e-20261103/e2e-service-flashinfer/lm-eval-gsm8k.log` (all 1319 questions, five-shot):

```text
|Tasks|Version|     Filter     |n-shot|  Metric   |   |Value |   |Stderr|
|-----|------:|----------------|-----:|-----------|---|-----:|---|-----:|
|gsm8k|      3|flexible-extract|     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9234|±  |0.0073|
|     |       |strict-match    |     5|exact_match|↑  |0.9234|±  |0.0073|
```

@@ -179,3 +179,84 @@ def test_compiled_matmul_reaches_batch_invariant_out_overloads(op):
         assert torch.equal(out, fn(xs)), f"compiled {op} bypassed the BI kernel (M={m})"
         row = out[..., needle, :] if row is None else row
         assert torch.equal(out[..., needle, :], row)
+
+
+def _persistent_operands(m, k, n, dtype, seed=0):
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE_TYPE).manual_seed(seed)
+    x = torch.randn(m, k, device=DEVICE_TYPE, generator=g).to(dtype)
+    w = (torch.randn(n, k, device=DEVICE_TYPE, generator=g) * 0.02).to(dtype)
+    return x, w.t()
+
+
+def test_matmul_persistent_split_k_plan_depends_only_on_k_and_n():
+    assert bi._split_k_plan(4096, 64) == (8, 512)
+    assert bi._split_k_plan(65536, 64) == (16, 4096)
+    assert bi._split_k_plan(1024, 64) == (2, 512)
+    assert bi._split_k_plan(1023, 64)[0] == 1
+    assert bi._split_k_plan(4096, 65)[0] == 1
+    assert bi._split_k_plan(4096, 4096)[0] == 1
+    assert bi._block_size_k(torch.float32) == 32
+    assert bi._block_size_k(torch.bfloat16) == bi._block_size_k(torch.float16) == 64
+
+
+@skip_unsupported
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("m", "k", "n"),
+    [
+        (1, 4096, 64),
+        (64, 4096, 64),
+        (4096, 4096, 64),
+        (17, 4104, 64),
+        (33, 4096, 63),
+        (3, 1000, 129),
+        (5, 4096, 129280),
+        (16, 1, 1),
+        (0, 4096, 64),
+        (7, 0, 9),
+    ],
+)
+def test_matmul_persistent_matches_fp64_reference(m, k, n, dtype):
+    x, b = _persistent_operands(m, k, n, dtype)
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE_TYPE).manual_seed(1)
+    bias = torch.randn(n, device=DEVICE_TYPE, generator=g).to(dtype)
+    ref = (x.double() @ b.double()).float()
+    tol = {"rtol": 2e-2, "atol": 2e-2}
+    torch.testing.assert_close(bi.matmul_persistent(x, b).float(), ref, **tol)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        bi.matmul_persistent(x, b, bias).float(), ref + bias.float(), **tol
+    )
+
+
+@skip_unsupported
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("m", "k", "n"), [(1, 4096, 64), (1024, 4096, 64), (7, 512, 129)]
+)
+def test_matmul_persistent_strided_bias(m, k, n):
+    x, b = _persistent_operands(m, k, n, torch.bfloat16)
+    bias = torch.randn(2 * n, device=DEVICE_TYPE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)[::2]
+    assert bias.stride(0) == 2
+    actual = bi.matmul_persistent(x, b, bias)
+    expected = bi.matmul_persistent(x, b, bias.contiguous())
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+@skip_unsupported
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16, torch.float32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("k", "n"), [(4096, 64), (4096, 1024), (4104, 64), (512, 4096)]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("m", [1, 2, 7, 16, 17, 33, 64, 65, 129, 1000])
+def test_matmul_persistent_batch_invariant(m, k, n, dtype):
+    x, b = _persistent_operands(m, k, n, dtype)
+    bias = torch.randn(n, device=DEVICE_TYPE).to(dtype)
+    y = bi.matmul_persistent(x, b, bias)
+    per_row = torch.cat([bi.matmul_persistent(x[i : i + 1], b, bias) for i in range(m)])
+    assert torch.equal(y, per_row), f"batch dependence at m={m}"
+    perm = torch.randperm(m, device=DEVICE_TYPE)
+    assert torch.equal(bi.matmul_persistent(x[perm], b, bias), y[perm]), (
+        f"position dependence at m={m}"
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(y, bi.matmul_persistent(x, b, bias)), (
+        f"nondeterministic at m={m}"
+    )

@@ -11,7 +11,6 @@
 import vllm.envs as envs
 from vllm.model_executor.determinism.batch_invariant_configs import (
     _get_descriptor_matmul_config,
-    _get_matmul_config,
     resolve_tuned_matmul_configs,
 )
 from vllm.platforms import current_platform
@@ -45,96 +44,279 @@ def _compute_pid(tile_id, num_pid_in_group, num_pid_m, GROUP_SIZE_M):
     return pid_m, pid_n
 
 
+# Batch-invariant matmul: every output element is one fp32 accumulation over K
+# in ascending order, from identical `tl.dot` instructions. What is summed is a
+# function of (K, N, dtype) only -- never of M: K is cut into S chunks of
+# k_chunk, each chunk is accumulated from zero, and the chunk partials are added
+# in ascending order before the bias and the single rounding. BLOCK_SIZE_K
+# groups the k-tiles inside a chunk, so it is fixed per dtype for the same
+# reason. Everything else -- tile height, how many chunks a CTA walks, whether
+# the partials are summed by the last program of a tile or by a second kernel --
+# only regroups work and may follow M.
+_SPLIT_K_MAX_N = 64
+_SPLIT_K_MIN_K = 1024
+_SPLIT_K_CHUNK_ALIGN = 64
+_SPLIT_K_MAX_WORKSPACE_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024
+
+
+def _block_size_k(dtype: torch.dtype) -> int:
+    """k-tile per `tl.dot`; fixed per dtype, as in the kernel this replaces."""
+    return 32 if dtype == torch.float32 else 64
+
+
+def _split_k_plan(K: int, N: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """(chunks, k_per_chunk) from (K, N) only.
+
+    Skinny-N GEMMs (the DSv4 indexer's weights_proj is M x 4096 @ 4096 x 64)
+    map onto a single column of CTAs and run latency-bound, which is what the
+    chunks are for. From N = 128 up the tiles already spread over the SMs and
+    the chunked accumulation only costs -- measured 1.5-4x slower than one pass
+    over K once M is large -- so those shapes keep the single pass, and with it
+    the arithmetic they have today.
+    """
+    if N > _SPLIT_K_MAX_N or K < _SPLIT_K_MIN_K:
+        return 1, K
+    want = max(1, min(16, K // 512))
+    per = (K + want - 1) // want
+    k_chunk = (
+        (per + _SPLIT_K_CHUNK_ALIGN - 1) // _SPLIT_K_CHUNK_ALIGN
+    ) * _SPLIT_K_CHUNK_ALIGN
+    return (K + k_chunk - 1) // k_chunk, k_chunk
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _reduce_tile(
+    ws_ptr,
